title: Retry policy maintenance with edge cases
final_response:
Done. Patched `retry_policy.py` to match its documented contract:

```python
def should_retry(method,status,attempt):
    """Retry GET/HEAD only, on 429 or 503, and only while attempt < 3. attempt starts at 1."""
    return str(method).upper() in ("GET", "HEAD") and status in (429, 503) and attempt < 3
```

Changes vs. the original (`return status >= 500`):
- Method restricted to GET/HEAD, case-insensitively (handles `get`, `HeAd`, etc.)
- Status restricted to exactly 429 or 503 (no longer any 5xx, and no non-int crashes)
- Retry only while `attempt < 3`
- Signature unchanged

Verification:
- `python3 test_visible.py` → "visible tests PASS"
- 18 additional edge-case checks passed, covering mixed-case methods, other methods (POST/PUT/DELETE/PATCH), 500/502/504/400/404 statuses, attempts 3 and 4, empty method, and `None` status.
